results.done: All 25 questions are registered, separated, independently verified and scored. (1) Separation by extract_candidate.py: model-visible requests (questions.json: id, shape, domain, question only), scorer-only keys/worked answers/wrong-answer examples (keys.json), and reference source documents (sources/) - the three-way split the command requires. (2) Independent verification by verify_keys.py: all 268 checks hold, exit 0 - 6 global checks (G1-G6), 195 per-question checks (Q1.1...Q25.7) and 67 cross-checks (X1-X67) that parse keys.json's own value strings and require agreement with the first-principles recomputation within the stated tolerances, so keys.json is the single source of key values. Every numerical key recomputed from first principles; dimensions, boundary operators (inclusive 'no more than', equality-permitted selections, strict regulatory thresholds), discrete selections and tolerance boundaries checked; all 56 claimed wrong answers falsified under the stated assumptions. (3) The five lookup questions (Q2, Q7, Q12, Q17, Q22) source-verified against four regulations: both 29 CFR 1910.146(b) oxygen definitions; 29 CFR 1910.95 Table G-16's 90/95/100 dBA rows (8, 4, 2 hours, slow response) and paragraph (g)'s audiometric provisions (baseline within 6 months, at least 14 hours workplace-noise-free, retest within 30 days); 40 CFR 141.62(b)'s maximum contaminant levels (fluoride 4.0 mg/L, nitrate 10 mg/L as nitrogen, arsenic 0.010 mg/L); 29 CFR 1910.147's attachment-means strength (no less than 50 pounds) and inspection frequency (at least annually). Every claimed verbatim quotation matched character-for-character against the archived July 1, 2014 annual editions (govinfo packages CFR-2014-title29-vol5 and CFR-2014-title40-vol23), editions identified by package identifier and GPO typesetting footer, not inferred from a current webpage; each regulation stability-cross-checked against the current eCFR as of 2026-10-01 (versioner API) - a 12-year span, satisfying the command's 'unchanged for at least three years' requirement. Twelve archive files (four govinfo PDFs, their four pdftotext extractions, and four eCFR snapshots), recorded as eight manifest archive records, are committed under sources/ with hashes, byte counts and retrieval dates in manifest.json. (4) The provider-free scorer (scorer.py) scores free-text answers against the keys with unit conversion and tolerance comparison, not regex presence: its self-test holds all 248 fixtures (25 model answers, 47 equivalent notations, 100 tolerance boundaries just inside and just past, 56 wrong answers, 20 discrete selections in both directions). (5) The suite guard tests/test_tier2_keys.py (17 tests) runs both instruments on the tree and proves each can fail on corrupted copies (convention 22): corrupted numeric key -> X1 fails; corrupted candidate export -> G1 fails; corrupted source archive -> Q2.1 fails; swapped model-answer steps -> Q5.5 fails; a corrupted key fails the intact model answer through the imported scorer; the version guard fails a one-byte change in any of the four versioned files. (6) The version record (versions.json, D44-style): the manifest's dataset_version/scorer_version name the current entry (candidate-2026-10-03.3), and the guard checks all four versioned files (questions.json, keys.json, scorer.py, verify_keys.py) hash to it; each change to the four is a new entry naming the change and its trigger (three entries: the initial five-question registration, two instrument repairs, and this complete registration). (7) The review checklist (evals/tier2/REVIEW.md) records every check and result, the four source records, the candidate provenance (the questions were authored by gpt-6.1-sol-pro with web_search/web_fetch/shell at the owner's direction - recorded as provenance, not a violation; no AI model was queried about the questions during verification), and the unresolved items.
results.not_done: The freeze. The command requires owner or qualified-reviewer signoff on the verification and the source review before the dataset and scorer versions freeze and before any paid use. Deterministic arithmetic verification is not independent subject-matter approval: the recomputation proves the keys follow from the stated inputs and formulas; it does not prove the questions are the right questions, that the formulas are the right models of the domains, or that the archived edition is the edition each question intends. manifest.json records the blocker (freeze_blocked_by: review-pending ...) and frozen=false. Tier 3 (the five-arm experiment) likewise remains NO_ACTION (see ARCH-20261002-118): its precondition 'after the dataset PR merges and required key/source review is complete' is not met by an unfrozen candidate.
